text: I think they want to help people who have problems, like poor families or sick children. Some people feel lucky, so they want to share. Also, giving money makes them feel good. I sometimes give a little money, for example, when there is a campaign at my university. I think it is important because small amounts from many people can become a big help.

tips.en: Cause and result make the reasoning logical.
tips.kk: Себеп пен салдар пайымдауды логикалы етеді.
tips.ru: Причина и следствие делают рассуждение логичным.
tips.example: Some people feel lucky, so they want to share

tips.en: A personal example makes the answer sincere.
tips.example: for example, when there is a campaign at my university

text: I think yes, because rich people earn much more money, so it is fair when they pay more. The government can use this money for hospitals, schools and roads, which help everybody. But the tax must not be too high, or rich people may move to another country. I believe a medium level is the best, so both sides are happy.

tips.en: Cause and result make the reasoning logical.
tips.kk: Себеп пен салдар пайымдауды логикалы етеді.
tips.ru: Причина и следствие делают рассуждение логичным.
tips.example: because rich people earn much more money, so it is fair when they pay more

tips.en: Contrast shows two sides of the issue, which works well in Part 3.

tips.ru: Противопоставление показывает две стороны вопроса — это сильный ход для Part 3.

text: I think both are good, but organisations are usually more reliable. They know who needs help most, and they can check how the money is used. If you give money to a person on the street, you don't know about their real situation. But helping directly is nice for small things, like giving food to a neighbour. So I would do both.

questions.question: Is it better to help people directly or through organisations?

text: Schools can organise projects where students help old people or clean the streets. When children do this, they understand how it feels to help. Teachers can also give a good example by being polite and fair. I think it's both the school's job and the parents' job, because children learn kindness from the people around them every day. If they start early, it becomes a habit.

tips.en: A concrete example makes the answer convincing and shows the idea is grounded.
tips.kk: Нақты мысал жауапты сенімді етіп, ойдың негізді екенін көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Конкретный пример делает ответ убедительным и показывает, что мысль не пустая.
